subject: RFI: Connectivity, HA and Air‑gapped Deployment Readiness
messages:
From: Rebecca Cole <rebecca.cole@enterprisecorp.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@enterprisecorp.com, infosec@enterprisecorp.com
Date: 2027-05-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: RFI: Private deployment capability questionnaire

Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is EnterpriseCorp's Private Deployment Capability Questionnaire (EC-RFP-PrivateDeployment-Questionnaire.xlsx). We need a completed response that covers networking, maintenance, patching/updates, key management/HSM support, and evidence for air‑gapped installation options.

High level asks:
- Confirm whether your on‑prem bundle supports air‑gapped installs and how updates are applied offline.
- Describe KMS/HSM integrations and whether you support FIPS-validated modules.
- Provide logging/audit retention and options for pushing logs to our SIEM in restricted networks.

Can you confirm receipt and give an estimated delivery date for the questionnaire answers and any supporting artifacts? Ideally within five business days.

Rebecca Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
EnterpriseCorp
Attachments: EC-RFP-PrivateDeployment-Questionnaire.xlsx

Rebecca — thanks, we received the questionnaire and will return a completed package. We're standing up a small cross‑functional team to handle the technical responses and artifacts. Preliminary timeline:
- Draft answers + attachments by EOD 2027-05-17
- Optional technical review call during the week of 2027-05-18 if you'd like a walkthrough

I've looped in Dev (install/runbook lead), Mina (security/compliance), and Neha (customer success/regulatory) to pull the required docs.

Couple of quick clarifying items while we work through the worksheet:
1) For evidence items (SOC2, pen test summaries), do you prefer redacted PDFs uploaded to your portal or secure SFTP transfer?
2) Any specific HSM vendors/versions we should prioritize (e.g., Thales Luna, AWS CloudHSM)?

Evelyn Hart

From: Rebecca Cole <rebecca.cole@enterprisecorp.com>

Subject: Re: RFI: Private deployment capability questionnaire

Thanks for the quick acknowledgement. A couple clarifications from our security team:
- Air‑gapped installs must support quarterly security patching via offline bundle delivery; we will bring the bundle to the isolated network.
- Any cryptographic modules must be FIPS 140‑2 validated; if you support PKCS#11, please list tested HSM vendors/versions.
- Audit logs must be retained for 365 days and exportable to our Splunk instance over an outbound-only log-forwarder.
- We require an initial security architecture diagram showing network zones, ingress/egress points, and maintenance windows.

We can accept redacted SOC2 and pen test reports uploaded to the HubSpot link below if you prefer. Also include any known limitations for fully air‑gapped mode (e.g., reduced telemetry, inability to use hosted fallback).

Rebecca

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Rebecca Cole <rebecca.cole@enterprisecorp.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-17T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Private deployment capability questionnaire — response package attached

Rebecca — please find our completed response below and the supporting artifacts attached. We can also do a focused technical walkthrough next week. Summary responses (high level):

1) Air‑gapped installation and offline updates- Supported. We provide an air‑gapped installer bundle (ISO + signed offline package bundles). Updates are applied via offline update bundles that include SHA256 checksums and GPG signatures; customers transfer bundles into the isolated environment and run an offline apply step in the runbook. We support quarterly patch cycles and ad‑hoc critical security releases.

2) Artifact verification and supply chain integrity- Signed artifacts: all binaries and packages are signed by Redwood's build pipeline using an organizational GPG key. We provide published SHA256 sums and an offline verification script. Supply chain attestations (SBOM in CycloneDX format) are provided for the server components.

3) KMS/HSM support and FIPS- Integration: we support PKCS#11 and standard KMIP connectors. Verified integrations: Thales Luna (v7.x), Utimaco (v4.x), and AWS CloudHSM for hybrid setups. FIPS posture: our HSM integrations work with FIPS‑validated modules; when customers provide a FIPS HSM, we operate with those validated modules. See attached RWI-KMS-HSM-Integration-Guide.pdf for details.

4) Network topology and high‑availability- We provide a recommended network topology with segregated management, control, and data planes. HA: active/standby control plane and clustered inference nodes with local KV cache replication. See attached architecture diagram in the runbook (RWI-Runbook-Preflight.md). In fully air‑gapped mode, HA is retained within the customer network; cross‑region fallback is not possible.

5) Logging, audit, and SIEM- Logs: application and audit logs can be retained locally for configurable retention (default 365 days). We support outbound-only log forwarding via an on‑prem forwarder (syslog/CEF) to your Splunk instance; where outbound is disallowed, we provide periodic offline log exports in compressed, signed bundles.

6) Evidence and compliance artifacts- We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II report and pen test summary under NDA. Attachments include RWI-SOC2-TypeII-Redacted.pdf. We also include an internal runbook and preflight checklist.

7) Support, SLAs and on‑site options- Standard private deployment SLA: 99.9% availability (customer infra dependent) with 24x7 severity‑1 support and 2‑hour response. On‑site deployment assistance available as a billable service; onboarding timelines typically 4–8 weeks depending on network approvals.

Limitations / Known constraints
- Fully air‑gapped mode disables Redwood telemetry and hosted fallback; feature flags requiring hosted APIs are disabled.
- Hardware acceleration (GPUs) must be provided/validated by the customer for dedicated high‑throughput inference clusters.

Attachments in this email: RWI-Airgap-Install-Guide-v1.2.pdf (installer + checksums), RWI-KMS-HSM-Integration-Guide.pdf, RWI-Runbook-Preflight.md, RWI-SOC2-TypeII-Redacted.pdf.

If this looks good, we'll upload the redacted SOC2 to your HubSpot link and schedule a technical walkthrough. Please let us know preferred times.

Best,

Evelyn Hart
Head of Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
